这项利益冲突必须披露。
我雇你，不是为了伤害他。
那些从没参与我们这场交易的人。
voices.It's proof someone wanted the file close: 这只能证明，有人想把这份档案结案。
我们现在仍然可以退出。
那这位客户会合你们的原则。
voices.We protect people, not secrets at any pr: 我们保护人，不是不计代价地守住秘密。
同意不该藏在小字条款里。
我可以授权你查阅，不代表资料归你所有。
很好，这样我们才能合作。
公开发布的合照可以查阅。
另一张不该由我们保留。
七天，我只剩这么多时间。
时间紧迫，也不能抹掉她的选择。
一枚印章说明不了整件事。
我们要找原始来源，不是传言。
我们把一位仍然活着的女性转出了医院。
voices.Only the entries she can request, please: 请只给她有权申请的记录。
这些已经足够让我们继续追问。
这还不能证明是谁下的命令。
但至少知道该往哪里查了。
我们从没承诺相爱一生。
那就别再让他们利用我们的婚姻。
出口的情况却指向另一种可能。
那扇门本来应该向外打开。
知道得不够。这仍然是我的责任。
他们是活生生的人，不是数字。
我们可以纪念他们，而不是利用他们。
我还没分手，他们就替我写好了分手声明。
不同的丑闻，同一家供应商。
我不会捏造自己的私生活。
收件人写的是你的旧名字。
我记得，当时有位女性还在呼吸。
你不必把所有事都告诉我们。
你在这里接受过治疗，后来康复了。
哪些事情公开，由你决定。
谁也无权夺走这个选择。
他们给了我一份死亡证明。
可这不能抹掉我签过的文件。
那只基金是我母亲建立的。
那它就不该成为谈判筹码。
那我们就质疑这份授权，不是质疑你的人生。
我不想再以他妻子的身份被介绍。
voices.We should stop pretending it still works: 我们不该再假装这段安排仍然有效。
他们告诉我们，那扇门没有问题。
你随时可以停止这次谈话。
我想把事情留下记录，但要谨慎。
还不清楚。我们先保留记录。
施工单是财务部门签的。
其中一份签名是他确认签署的。
我以为留在内部，就能把事情解决。
voices.Whatever the investigation requires. Not: 配合调查需要的一切，而不是只做对我有利的事。
我把信写给了一个我以为已经不在的人。
事务所仍然可以保持低调。
更正记录和对外公开，是两件事。
目前只能证明付钱给了供应商。用途还需要证据。
有人来打听过那份名单。
voices.Did they show identification?: 对方出示身份证明了吗？
你随时可以结束这通电话。
这才是真正该问的问题。
分手不会自动改写合同。
但我们可以重新制定计划。
我想要表决权，不是一个更好听的头衔。
终于有人把话说出来了。
我们可以把事务所经营得更好。
保护隐私没有问题，强迫沉默不行。
voices.Can the board do that?: 董事会真的有权这么做吗？
voices.I thought protecting you meant deciding: 我曾以为，保护你就是替你做决定。
我们只提交能够证实的材料。
还有当事人同意提供的材料。
不是每一道伤口，都属于公众。
voices.Even the part that hurts you?: 包括那些对你不利的部分？
我准备好说出亲眼看到的事了。
我只会依据自己保留的记录发言。
我们知道记录能证明什么。
也要说明它不能证明什么。
最该开口的时候，我没有开口。
这种平常的日子，真不错。
我们可以扩张，也可以保持小而专。
我想再争取一次机会，但前提是你也愿意。
voices.I'd like to see where this goes. No pres: 我想看看我们会走向哪里，不勉强。
voices.You don't need anyone to make this a hap: 美好的结局，不需要谁来成全你。
又有一位客户打来电话。
你准备好了，我们就开始。

CH01_S01.title: The Silver Check at Midnight
CH01_S01.entry: Vivian removes her wet gloves and slides a check across the desk. Olivia closes the door before touching the money.
CH01_S01.conflict: She wants a marriage to end but has not explained why.
CH01_S01.participation: You may ask about confidentiality, authority, and conflicts before considering the case.

CH01_S02.title: The Man in the Wedding Photo
CH01_S02.entry: Vivian turns a framed wedding photo toward you. Olivia reaches for the conflict-of-interest form.
CH01_S02.conflict: The groom is the fiancé you lost contact with three years ago. This creates a potential conflict for the client.
CH01_S02.participation: You may decline the case, arrange independent representation, or accept only preliminary information.

CH01_S03.title: She Refuses to Be the Villain
CH01_S03.entry: Vivian removes her ring beside a glass of water and pulls out a chair. Olivia marks the limits of confidentiality.
CH01_S03.conflict: Vivian will not frame her departure as destroying another woman or expose private marital details.
CH01_S03.participation: She explains that a looming shareholder vote makes the divorce urgent.

CH01_S04.title: The Name Among the Dead
CH01_S04.entry: Olivia shines a flashlight over an old fire casualty list. Vivian pauses at the door to leave you space.
CH01_S04.conflict: Your former identity is marked deceased. The list does not establish who submitted that information.
CH01_S04.participation: An anonymous message offers a way to verify the original fire records tomorrow.

CH02_S01.title: Bad News in the Morning
CH02_S01.entry: Olivia locks the uncashed check away. Lena arrives with images being used to blackmail a streamer.
CH02_S01.conflict: Ordinary clients still need help while the wealthy client’s case competes for attention.
CH02_S01.participation: You may set intake priorities and separate the risks of each case.

CH02_S02.title: The Contract with Covered Names
CH02_S02.entry: Theo covers the names on a contract while explaining fees and consent. Vivian turns her phone toward you.
CH02_S02.conflict: The small case and the million-dollar proposal cannot share one blanket permission.
CH02_S02.participation: Independent legal review can separate Vivian’s representation from your personal conflict.

CH02_S03.title: The Streamer’s Last Photo
CH02_S03.entry: Lena separates an authorized public photo from a private image of uncertain origin. Olivia passes you notes.
CH02_S03.conflict: Keeping or circulating the private image could cause a second privacy violation.
CH02_S03.participation: You may sort the material by source and permission and prepare a removal request.

CH02_S04.title: A Marriage Before the Vote
CH02_S04.entry: Theo points to a corporate announcement on his phone. Vivian stops at the rooftop door.
CH02_S04.conflict: A spouse’s voting authority still needs independent legal interpretation.
CH02_S04.participation: You may preserve the records without letting your personal history dictate Vivian’s exit.

CH03_S01.title: A Cold Draft in the Archives
CH03_S01.entry: Theo draws a fire index from a box. Olivia holds the page steady.
CH03_S01.conflict: The public index lacks the originals, and the names have been changed more than once.
CH03_S01.participation: You may request certified copies or arrange access through an authorized lawyer.

CH03_S02.title: Medical Folder Seven
CH03_S02.entry: Mara offers an authorized transfer entry. Theo asks to see only the parts you may legally request.
CH03_S02.conflict: Other unidentified survivors’ information remains private.
CH03_S02.participation: You may compare the transfer time and destination with the conflicting death entry.

CH03_S03.title: Signatures and Seals
CH03_S03.entry: Olivia places two versions on a lightbox. Theo offers a magnifying glass.
CH03_S03.conflict: One receipt number leads to a closed contractor account.
CH03_S03.participation: The contractor number is a lead, not proof of who ordered the change.

CH03_S04.title: An Unknown Number in the Stairwell
CH03_S04.entry: Gabriel finishes a call at a distance, steps toward you, then stops. Theo moves between you.
CH03_S04.conflict: Gabriel has not yet verified your identity.
CH03_S04.participation: You may ask Theo to relay a message or decline direct contact.

CH04_S01.title: A Wedding Without a Kiss
CH04_S01.entry: Vivian pauses the wedding footage at a moment when their hands remain apart. Theo lowers the volume.
CH04_S01.conflict: Social-media edits turned a formal arrangement into a perfect love story.
CH04_S01.participation: You may preserve relevant evidence while respecting what Vivian does not wish to publish.

CH04_S02.title: The Price of a Ring
CH04_S02.entry: Vivian places her ring beside a trust explanation. Olivia weighs down two separate clauses with coins.
CH04_S02.conflict: Vivian refuses to trade employee welfare for her own freedom.
CH04_S02.participation: You may separate her marital interests from the employees’ independent rights.

CH04_S03.title: The Lawyer Who Gives No Answer
CH04_S03.entry: Theo closes the reference book and returns the pen to Vivian.
CH04_S03.conflict: The voting arrangement may require outside counsel; the agency cannot issue a legal ruling.
CH04_S03.participation: Vivian chooses her own adviser and negotiation terms.

CH04_S04.title: Two Exits from the Reception
CH04_S04.entry: Gabriel and Vivian stand on opposite sides of the hall. After exchanging a look, they move toward different exits.
CH04_S04.conflict: Public assumptions about their marriage could affect the trust.
CH04_S04.participation: You may propose a confidential announcement schedule within the authorized scope.

CH05_S01.title: Pier Forty-Seven
CH05_S01.entry: Lena opens an old newspaper and a site photograph. Theo compares them with the remaining exit.
CH05_S01.conflict: The site has been rebuilt; today’s structure is not the original scene.
CH05_S01.participation: Public plans and contemporary photographs may be compared carefully.

CH05_S02.title: The Last Door Latch
CH05_S02.entry: Olivia pins the old plans and fire approvals to a board. Theo traces the route with a transparent ruler.
CH05_S02.conflict: The latch position differs between two versions.
CH05_S02.participation: You may identify when the change occurred and preserve the document trail.

CH05_S03.title: The Page You Signed
CH05_S03.entry: Gabriel unfolds the repair-delay page he signed three years ago. His hand tightens, but he leaves it on the table.
CH05_S03.conflict: He confirms his signature while denying knowledge of a later instruction to lock the exit.
CH05_S03.participation: You may insist on verification and pause personal contact without accepting an apology.

CH05_S04.title: Footprints in the Rain
CH05_S04.entry: Lena places flowers beside the wall. Theo steps back to give you room.
CH05_S04.conflict: Relatives were turned away when they asked the company for help.
CH05_S04.participation: Their wishes can be recorded without using their grief or exposing your own history against your will.

CH06_S01.title: Smiles Behind the Red Carpet
CH06_S01.entry: Harper removes an earring and hands Olivia two publicity scripts. Lena watches the doorway.
CH06_S01.conflict: The company wants a breakup announcement for a relationship that never existed.
CH06_S01.participation: You may ask what Harper truly wants to leave: the contract, the campaign, or a relationship.

CH06_S02.title: The Same Watermark
CH06_S02.entry: Lena projects a leaked publicity image beside an old fire attachment. Olivia checks authorized metadata.
CH06_S02.conflict: A shared watermark does not identify the individual who leaked either file.
CH06_S02.participation: The vendor name Greybridge Media becomes a lead for further inquiry.

CH06_S03.title: An Empty Microphone
CH06_S03.entry: Harper folds the false statement and faces the cameras. Lena stands beside her.
CH06_S03.conflict: Refusing the campaign may cost Harper an endorsement.
CH06_S03.participation: You may help prepare a truthful alternative that does not disclose anyone else’s private life.

CH06_S04.title: An Invitation to the Dead
CH06_S04.entry: Olivia prints a receipt from the secure mailbox. Theo checks the authorized delivery address.
CH06_S04.conflict: A Greybridge contact appears to know your former identity.
CH06_S04.participation: The invitation proposes a meeting with someone who kept an old ledger.

CH07_S01.title: The Ticket Never Used
CH07_S01.entry: Mara takes an unused train ticket from her wallet. Theo asks permission before receiving it.
CH07_S01.conflict: She helped arrange the transfer but does not know who altered the later account.
CH07_S01.participation: Her hospital transfer reference can be checked independently.

CH07_S02.title: Two Different Lists
CH07_S02.entry: Olivia overlays hospital records and the company’s casualty list. A replaced entry appears.
CH07_S02.conflict: The company’s list marked a survivor as deceased, affecting later public records.
CH07_S02.participation: Certified differences can establish where the erroneous conclusion entered the record.

CH07_S03.title: The Sealed Hospital Room
CH07_S03.entry: Mara opens photographs of the old ward. Theo stays beside you as you view your permitted records.
CH07_S03.conflict: Recovery records concern private health information and do not require public disclosure.
CH07_S03.participation: You may confirm your survival while keeping the details private.

CH07_S04.title: He Thought the Fire Took You
CH07_S04.entry: Gabriel opens a box of old condolence cards. Theo waits by the door so you can choose the distance.
CH07_S04.conflict: The false death notice does not excuse Gabriel’s repair-delay signature.
CH07_S04.participation: The notice and real transfer record can be examined without an embrace or reconciliation.

CH08_S01.title: The Box Her Mother Left
CH08_S01.entry: Vivian takes out her mother’s employee-trust passbook and a photograph. Theo moves unrelated papers aside.
CH08_S01.conflict: Family directors have tied her inheritance to the marriage.
CH08_S01.participation: Her priority is the employee medical fund her mother built.

CH08_S02.title: Four Signatures
CH08_S02.entry: Vivian lays out four documents granting different powers. Olivia marks each authorization period.
CH08_S02.conflict: Marital consent and corporate authority cannot be treated as the same thing.
CH08_S02.participation: You may compare valid authority with expired proxy arrangements.

CH08_S03.title: Her First Introduction
CH08_S03.entry: Vivian removes the name badge identifying her as a director’s wife and replaces it with her own speaking card.
CH08_S03.conflict: Her statement could be misreported as a declaration of marital war.
CH08_S03.participation: You may keep the speech focused on employees and verifiable facts.

CH08_S04.title: No Rivalry Between Them
CH08_S04.entry: Gabriel holds the door without touching Vivian. She pauses to give him her final negotiation boundaries.
CH08_S04.conflict: Their arrangement once protected both of them but now restricts them.
CH08_S04.participation: Vivian proposes an exit that preserves the trust.

CH09_S01.title: The Night Worker’s Hands
CH09_S01.entry: Jonas repairs the handle of an old thermos. Lena keeps the recorder in her bag until he agrees.
CH09_S01.conflict: He worries that speaking could cost him his job.
CH09_S01.participation: You may discuss anonymity, legal support, and a safe way to communicate.

CH09_S02.title: The Exit That Never Opened
CH09_S02.entry: Jonas marks the escape route on an old plan. Theo places a photograph beside it for comparison.
CH09_S02.conflict: Time and trauma may affect a witness’s recollection.
CH09_S02.participation: His account can be checked against an independent photograph.

CH09_S03.title: A Call Without a Clear Threat
CH09_S03.entry: Theo takes a legal liaison call while Olivia records the permission and time. Gabriel is elsewhere.
CH09_S03.conflict: A suggestion that benefits may stop is concerning, but the caller’s responsibility is unverified.
CH09_S03.participation: You may preserve the communication while leaving the witness free to continue or withdraw.

CH09_S04.title: The Name He Will Give
CH09_S04.entry: Jonas tightens his coat. Lena slides her contact card toward him.
CH09_S04.conflict: Reporters want a personal accusation; he refuses to guess.
CH09_S04.participation: He identifies a department, not an unverified individual suspect.

CH10_S01.title: Three Similar Signatures
CH10_S01.entry: After the expert leaves, Theo lays out three authorized documents. Olivia checks the strokes with a penlight.
CH10_S01.conflict: Similar electronic signatures may come from different accounts.
CH10_S01.participation: You may separate the signature Gabriel confirms from material needing independent authentication.

CH10_S02.title: One Minute in the Boardroom
CH10_S02.entry: Gabriel pauses beside old minutes. Vivian points to the absent-vote column.
CH10_S02.conflict: He requested a repair delay and later remained silent about the family’s statement.
CH10_S02.participation: You may establish the sequence and examine his failure to speak up.

CH10_S03.title: An Apology That Is Not Enough
CH10_S03.entry: Gabriel slides a written account of his responsibility toward you. Theo does not answer for him.
CH10_S03.conflict: An apology cannot repair the fire’s consequences or the missing years.
CH10_S03.participation: You may keep the statement, ask for action, or decline a private conversation.

CH10_S04.title: Another Unsent Letter
CH10_S04.entry: Gabriel offers a letter written three years ago. Olivia places it in a separate envelope to reduce pressure.
CH10_S04.conflict: The letter is personal correspondence, not courtroom evidence.
CH10_S04.participation: You may read it, keep it sealed, or refuse it permanently.

CH11_S01.title: Two Proofs of Identity
CH11_S01.entry: Theo lays out your old registration and verified current-name records. Olivia puts away unnecessary copies.
CH11_S01.conflict: Correcting the record requires verification; publicity remains a separate choice.
CH11_S01.participation: You may choose a correction process and how you wish to be addressed publicly.

CH11_S02.title: Who Removed the Entry?
CH11_S02.entry: Lena brings lawfully released procurement records. Theo checks the Greybridge payments.
CH11_S02.conflict: A payment trail still does not establish the precise instruction given.
CH11_S02.participation: Martin’s crisis-management contract covered the months after the fire.

CH11_S03.title: The Person at the Door
CH11_S03.entry: Mara pauses at the entrance and points to a doorbell that has since been replaced.
CH11_S03.conflict: She recalls an employee asking about survivor registration but did not see identification.
CH11_S03.participation: You may preserve her account without inventing a name or request a formal interview.

CH11_S04.title: A Message to Your Former Name
CH11_S04.entry: With prior permission, Gabriel calls remotely about the correction notice. Theo remains beside you.
CH11_S04.conflict: The caller is not physically present, and you may end or skip the call.
CH11_S04.participation: You may discuss the records without agreeing to a personal relationship.

CH12_S01.title: Who Will Care for the Dog?
CH12_S01.entry: An elderly rescue dog walks slowly between former partners. Olivia opens veterinary and care schedules.
CH12_S01.conflict: Both people love the dog, but their care arrangements differ.
CH12_S01.participation: You may work toward practical care based on the animal’s needs rather than a winner and loser.

CH12_S02.title: The Trademark Between Them
CH12_S02.entry: The former business partners each carry packaging boxes. Theo separates the trademark filing from the stock.
CH12_S02.conflict: A breakup does not automatically transfer intellectual-property rights.
CH12_S02.participation: You may explore a transition license, a buyout, or an agreed wind-down.

CH12_S03.title: The Partner’s Key
CH12_S03.entry: Olivia places a spare key before you. Lena opens the partnership terms.
CH12_S03.conflict: Olivia wants real authority and refuses unlimited overtime.
CH12_S03.participation: You may offer a genuine decision-making role rather than another verbal promise.

CH12_S04.title: Your Pace, Your Company
CH12_S04.entry: Theo leaves room at the table for your answer. Gabriel appears only if an authorized, willing meeting has been arranged.
CH12_S04.conflict: Neither man is a prize you must choose.
CH12_S04.participation: You may prefer privacy, friendship, or a relationship that meets the necessary boundaries.

CH13_S01.title: Terms Across the Table
CH13_S01.entry: Vivian places the trust terms in the middle. Gabriel moves his own signature page toward her.
CH13_S01.conflict: The company’s proposed settlement includes a sweeping silence provision about the accident.
CH13_S01.participation: You may refuse to accept such a clause on the client’s behalf.

CH13_S02.title: The Line Through the Clause
CH13_S02.entry: Theo marks the broad non-disparagement clause. Olivia explains the risk to Vivian.
CH13_S02.conflict: Removing one clause does not resolve every issue; independent counsel must finalize the language.
CH13_S02.participation: You may distinguish legitimate privacy protections from barriers to truthful reporting.

CH13_S03.title: The Withheld Medical Fund
CH13_S03.entry: Vivian waits at the door. Lena gives her notice of the beneficiaries’ meeting.
CH13_S03.conflict: The company delays funding while pressuring Vivian to change her position.
CH13_S03.participation: You may consider independent civil action, public oversight, or continued negotiation.

CH13_S04.title: Please Do Not Protect Me Tonight
CH13_S04.entry: Gabriel puts the old engagement-ring box in his own pocket. Theo steps toward the window to leave space.
CH13_S04.conflict: Making decisions for you repeats an old failure, even when described as help.
CH13_S04.participation: You decide whether his promise to respect boundaries permits further cooperation.

CH14_S01.title: The Originals Leave Your Hands
CH14_S01.entry: Theo seals certified copies into evidence packets. Olivia checks the seal numbers.
CH14_S01.conflict: Truth does not justify submitting private material without permission.
CH14_S01.participation: You may verify both the submission list and the authority to share it.

CH14_S02.title: One Form, Two Destinations
CH14_S02.entry: Vivian places a public account beside a sealed private version. Lena does not photograph them.
CH14_S02.conflict: The extent of disclosure changes the risks to individuals and employees.
CH14_S02.participation: You may separate public facts from confidential health information.

CH14_S03.title: A Surname Is Not a Weapon
CH14_S03.entry: Gabriel removes his badge and offers Theo a document.
CH14_S03.conflict: Willingness to testify must still be backed by verification.
CH14_S03.participation: You may submit the adverse statement and relevant originals through the authorized process.

CH14_S04.title: The Last Witness
CH14_S04.entry: Jonas and Mara exchange a nod, then walk toward separate entrances.
CH14_S04.conflict: Either may decide not to testify publicly; other evidence can still support the case.
CH14_S04.participation: Their individual choices are recorded before the hearing.

CH15_S01.title: A Seat for Everyone
CH15_S01.entry: Vivian gives the front row to employee representatives. Gabriel reviews his statement behind them. Theo checks everyone is ready.
CH15_S01.conflict: The participants seek different outcomes: freedom, welfare, remediation, and accountability.
CH15_S01.participation: You may state your own aims without making a witness’s decision for them.

CH15_S02.title: No Perfect Testimony
CH15_S02.entry: Theo projects a timeline while Lena checks every quotation against its source.
CH15_S02.conflict: One missing page does not erase all valid records.
CH15_S02.participation: You may separate direct evidence, supporting material, and what remains unknown.

CH15_S03.title: He Names His Own Failure
CH15_S03.entry: Gabriel signs his formal statement. Vivian replaces the pen cap without applauding.
CH15_S03.conflict: Admitting fault neither wins you back nor settles compensation.
CH15_S03.participation: You may evaluate his actions rather than accept an emotional performance.

CH15_S04.title: The Price of Leaving
CH15_S04.entry: Vivian places her ring in a small box and gives Olivia notice of interim trust protection.
CH15_S04.conflict: Divorce and regulatory processes still need formal completion.
CH15_S04.participation: The agency’s present work may close without deciding your romantic future.

CH16_S01.title: Open at Nine
CH16_S01.entry: Olivia hangs the new opening sign. Lena files the news clipping rather than displaying it as a trophy.
CH16_S01.conflict: A major case does not replace everyday operations.
CH16_S01.participation: You may expand, remain a small practice, or reserve pro bono capacity.

CH16_S02.title: Three Plans, Different Costs
CH16_S02.entry: Olivia brings three plans: pro bono work, boutique consulting, and partnership expansion. Theo marks their costs.
CH16_S02.conflict: Unlimited free services cannot coexist with unlimited resources.
CH16_S02.participation: You may set a feasible budget and a genuine management arrangement.

CH16_S03.title: The Chair Beside You
CH16_S03.entry: A chair faces your place at the table. Gabriel or Theo appears only on an eligible, mutually willing route; otherwise it remains empty.
CH16_S03.conflict: Reconciliation, a new relationship, friendship, and independence are all valid outcomes.
CH16_S03.participation: Your expressed wishes, trust, and demonstrated repair determine the relationship separately from the case.

CH16_S04.title: The Next Client
CH16_S04.entry: A new client knocks. Olivia turns toward you. Vivian returns completed papers only if that visit has been earned.
CH16_S04.conflict: The next person has a life of their own, not another copy of your lost-fiancé mystery.
CH16_S04.participation: You may return to the available agency cases without inventing an endless authored season.

CH01.title: A Million Dollars to Leave
CH01.goal: Establish the client’s wishes and the agency’s conflict of interest.

CH02.title: Secrets Are Not for Sale
CH02.goal: Set separate permissions and protect the clients’ privacy.

CH03.title: A Death Recorded in Error
CH03.goal: Compare the original transfer records with the death entry.

CH04.title: A Marriage on Paper
CH04.goal: Separate the marriage from the employee trust.

CH05.title: Pier Forty-Seven
CH05.goal: Verify the exit changes and Gabriel’s acknowledged signature.

CH06.title: A Story She Refuses to Perform
CH06.goal: Help Harper reject fabricated publicity and verify the vendor lead.

CH07.title: The Survivor in the Records
CH07.goal: Confirm the transfer history without forcing public disclosure.

CH08.title: Her Mother’s Fund
CH08.goal: Protect Vivian’s independent authority and employee welfare.

CH09.title: What the Night Shift Saw
CH09.goal: Record only what witnesses freely agree to share.

CH10.title: Responsibility Without Excuses
CH10.goal: Separate admitted failures from instructions still requiring proof.

CH11.title: A Name Returned
CH11.goal: Choose a record-correction process and trace the procurement trail.

CH12.title: The Work of Leaving
CH12.goal: Resolve practical exits and define the agency’s partnership.

CH13.title: Terms No One Can Accept for Her
